43-4161.00:18572.short: Receive, check and file personnel documents (contracts, evaluations, leave, certificates, grievances) in the AFAS dossier.

steps.what: Collect documents arriving by Outlook, Teams, paper and AFAS Pocket
Read document, identify type, check completeness and signatures

loop.input: scanned or PDF document (no medical documents)
loop.output: document type, employee number, key fields, signature present yes/no
loop.check: Fields validated in code against AFAS: employee exists, dates plausible, field formats; checklist per document type
loop.stop: One pass plus one retry; low confidence or failed validation goes to the exceptions queue for the administrator
loop.why_not_simpler: Documents arrive as free-form scans and PDFs from managers and agencies; templates are not used consistently, so fixed parsing breaks.

steps.what: Key fields into AFAS and file document in the digital dossier
Chase managers and employees for missing or unsigned items
Handle grievances and medical-related leave files with restricted access

43-4161.00:18572.design: One intake mailbox and the AFAS Pocket upload feed a document queue. AFAS Jonas, or a small extraction step on the governed data platform, reads each non-medical document into dossier fields; code checks them against AFAS and a checklist per document type, and the administrator approves or fixes from an exceptions queue. Scheduled reminders chase missing items; grievance and medical files bypass the model entirely.
43-4161.00:18572.previous_blocker: Documents arrive in free form from many senders, and reading them needed a person. Rule-based OCR could not cope with mixed layouts and handwriting.
43-4161.00:18572.enabler_now: Document-to-field extraction is now in AFAS Profit 8 (Jonas) and in general models, and validation code is quick to write with AI coding tools.
43-4161.00:18572.still_hard: Grievances and medical leave need human handling and strict access. Extraction error rates on Dutch scans are unknown, and a wrong dossier field can carry into payroll or a legal dispute.
43-4161.00:18572.human_edge: Judging whether a grievance or evaluation is complete and fair, and handling sensitive files discreetly with the employee and HRBP.

ambition.what: A weekly dossier-completeness report per site and manager, with missing signed contracts and expired certificates listed by name.

43-4161.00:18572.altitude: The administrator spends time on the exceptions queue and sensitive files instead of filing. They own the document checklist per type and decide when a dossier counts as complete.

What a complete evaluation or grievance file must contain for a later dismissal or appeal.

Personal data processing in a new HR system needs works council consent under WOR art. 27(1)(k).
Health data is special-category under GDPR Art. 9 and should stay out of model prompts.

Validation of structured HR records needs no model at run time.

Site production figures exist in Excel on SharePoint in a stable layout per site.

Payroll correction count per month caused by HR data errors.

43-4161.00:2702.short: Handle employee requests for pension, allowances, bike plan and sickness-insurance matters; check eligibility and process changes in AFAS.

steps.what: Receive and answer employee benefit questions and requests by mail or phone

loop.input: employee question in Teams or AFAS InSite, plus owned policy pages on SharePoint and the employee's contract group from AFAS
loop.output: answer quoting the policy page; personal entitlements come from a deterministic AFAS lookup, never generated
loop.check: the answer must cite a policy page; no answer if there is no citation; health terms are filtered out before the prompt
loop.stop: one answer attempt; if there is no citation, or the case is about sickness or a personal situation, open a ticket in the HR queue with the profile attached
loop.why_not_simpler: Questions come in free text and the matching CAO and policy pages vary by contract group. A FAQ page alone was not used.

steps.what: Check eligibility against CAO, contract group and policy
Enter the mutation in AFAS: pension, allowance, bike plan, deduction
Report to pension fund, sickness insurer or UWV and file the paperwork

43-4161.00:2702.design: Employees request bike plan, allowance and pension changes through AFAS InSite or Pocket workflow forms. Deterministic rules on contract group and CAO check eligibility, and after the administrator approves, the workflow writes the mutation to AFAS before the payroll cut-off. A Teams answer desk on owned SharePoint policy pages answers general questions, quotes personal entitlements from an AFAS lookup, and opens a ticket for anything about sickness or personal circumstances. Pension fund and insurer reports are generated from AFAS for the administrator to check and send.
43-4161.00:2702.previous_blocker: Requests came by mail and phone, and the CAO and policy rules were in PDFs, not in a table, so every case was read and re-keyed by hand. Health and absence data made people wary of automation.
43-4161.00:2702.enabler_now: AFAS workflows and InSite forms are already licensed and only need configuring. Answer desks grounded in owned content, with ticket escalation, are proven in HR. AI coding makes the rules table and report exports cheap to build.
43-4161.00:2702.still_hard: Exceptions such as part-time changes mid-month, retroactive corrections, and staff covered by both CAOs. Sickness insurer and UWV cases involve special-category health data, which must stay out of model prompts. The works council must agree, and the policy content must be kept current.
43-4161.00:2702.human_edge: Explaining a pension or sickness-pay consequence to a worried employee, and spotting when a benefit question is really about illness or money trouble.

ambition.what: Warehouse and transport shift workers without a desk get Dutch and Polish answers on their phone through Teams or AFAS Pocket, outside office hours.

43-4161.00:2702.altitude: The administrator approves mutations from a queue instead of typing them, owns the policy pages and rules table, and handles the tickets that need a person.

reach.task: Monthly payroll close and correction runs
reach.learn: Which benefit mutations cause corrections, so the rules and cut-off checks catch them earlier.
How a scheme change turns into rule rows and policy pages before it goes live.

Benefits include sector pension, travel allowance, bike plan and CAO allowances administered in AFAS.
The AFAS licence includes InSite or Pocket workflows.

Which pension fund and sickness insurer are used, and whether they accept file uploads or only portals.
Whether policy content on SharePoint is current and has an owner.

How many payroll corrections per month come from late or wrong benefit mutations?

43-4161.00:2691.short: Answer employee questions on leave, salary scales, benefits, eligibility and CAO rules by mail, Teams and phone.

steps.what: Receive and sort questions from mail, Teams, phone and walk-ins

loop.input: employee question text in Dutch, English or Polish
loop.output: topic label: personal entitlement, CAO/policy, or escalate
loop.check: label must be in the fixed topic list; health or complaint words route to escalate
loop.stop: one classification call; low confidence or no label goes to the HR queue
loop.why_not_simpler: questions arrive as free text in several languages; keyword rules miss too many

steps.what: Look up the employee's own data in AFAS: leave balance, scale, contract
Find the matching CAO article or policy on SharePoint

loop.input: question plus approved HR content pages tagged by owner
loop.output: top passages with page and article reference
loop.check: answer may only cite retrieved approved passages; no passage means no answer
loop.stop: one retrieval and one answer draft; no match goes to the HR queue
loop.why_not_simpler: employees phrase questions in their own words; a fixed FAQ menu covers too little of the CAO

steps.what: Write and send the answer to the employee

loop.input: policy passage and the AFAS figure
loop.output: short answer with the figure quoted verbatim and the source linked, marked as AI
loop.check: figures are inserted by code, not generated; tone rules in configuration; weekly sample reviewed by the administrator
loop.stop: one draft; if the check fails the question becomes a ticket
loop.why_not_simpler: policy answers need plain wording fitted to the question; templates alone cover only the top questions

steps.what: Handle escalated questions: disputes, exceptions, sensitive situations

43-4161.00:2691.design: Put a Teams bot in front of the HR mailbox. It quotes personal entitlements through a deterministic AFAS lookup and answers CAO and policy questions from SharePoint content with named owners, in a bounded retrieve-and-draft loop. Anything it cannot answer becomes a ticket in the existing HR queue with the employee profile attached, and a monthly report shows content gaps.
43-4161.00:2691.previous_blocker: Answers depend on contract type, site, CAO and tenure. Old chatbots could not combine personal data with free-text policy, so wrong answers about pay were a real risk.
43-4161.00:2691.enabler_now: Models can read free-text questions and cite approved content, and AFAS exposes personal data through GetConnectors. A comparable HR bot runs at scale on a daily HR data sync [S1].
43-4161.00:2691.still_hard: Keeping the CAO and policy content current, per site and per CAO, takes owner time every month. Shop-floor workers without a work account need another way in, such as WhatsApp or a kiosk.
43-4161.00:2691.human_edge: Disputes, hardship cases and questions where the honest answer is 'it depends on your manager' need a person who knows the sites and the people.

ambition.what: Flex workers from the three agencies get answers on site rules, shift allowances and certificates. Today they mostly ask their agency or their team lead.

43-4161.00:2691.altitude: The administrator stops typing answers and becomes the content owner for HR answers. They decide which topics the bot may answer and they handle the escalations.

reach.learn: How shift and overtime allowances are calculated, so payslip questions can be answered without a ticket
Where the CAO leaves room for judgement, so the bot routes those questions instead of answering

Look up contract history, dates, scale and absence in AFAS

loop.output: request type, employee number, requested fields, requester, legal basis claimed
loop.check: employee number must match AFAS; request type from a fixed list; legal-basis rules table decides whether consent is required
loop.stop: one pass plus one retry; low confidence or unknown type goes to the administrator's queue

reach.task: Setting vacancy requirements and running interviews
reach.learn: Which requirements are hard rules and which are judgement, to write knockout questions per vacancy type.
Which missing certificates can be trained after hire, so candidates are not rejected for them.

evidence.claim: Screening applicants is high-risk under AI Act Annex III 4(a) from 2 December 2027.
A rejection letter can be automated but the decision cannot rest solely on automated processing.
Applicant evaluation fits a copilot pattern at autonomy 2 or below.

assumptions: Recruitee knockout questions and mail templates are available in Noordhaven's plan.
Most vacancies have clear hard requirements (licence, certificates, shift availability).
unknowns: Applications per month and the share rejected on hard requirements.
Whether candidates upload licence and certificate scans today.
Whether recruiters already use a scorecard.
research_questions: What share of rejections in the past year were on hard requirements that knockout questions could catch?
How accurate is licence and code 95 expiry extraction on 100 real candidate uploads?
Does legal review confirm that fact extraction without ranking stays outside Annex III 4(a)?

43-4161.00:2698.short: Tell applicants by mail or phone that they are hired or rejected, and record it in Recruitee.

steps.what: Collect the hiring decision from manager or recruiter by mail
Choose a template and personalise the acceptance or rejection message
Send the message; call interviewed candidates who are rejected
Log the outcome and set the data-retention date

43-4161.00:2698.design: Configure Recruitee so the hiring manager or recruiter records the decision as a stage move with a reason code. That move triggers the matching Dutch or English template with a short delay so it can be undone, and sets the retention date for deletion. Interviewed candidates who are rejected get a phone call from the recruiter or administrator, prompted by a task. No custom code is needed.
43-4161.00:2698.previous_blocker: Decisions arrived by mail and phone, not as a stage in the system, so nothing could trigger a message. Templates sat in Word on SharePoint.
43-4161.00:2698.enabler_now: Recruitee stage automations, templates and retention settings already exist; the work is configuration and getting managers to record the decision in Recruitee. A model is not needed at run time.
43-4161.00:2698.still_hard: Getting hiring managers on three sites to record decisions in Recruitee instead of calling HR. Delicate cases, such as internal candidates or people who were close, still need a human message.
43-4161.00:2698.human_edge: The call to a rejected internal candidate or a strong finalist, and handling questions about why. That conversation keeps people willing to apply again.

ambition.what: Applicants who are never interviewed get a clear answer within five working days, plus an offer to stay in the talent pool for 12 months with consent.

43-4161.00:2698.altitude: The administrator no longer writes letters. They own the template set and reason codes, check the weekly list of applicants without an answer, and keep the calls that matter.

reach.task: Making offers and handling offer negotiation
reach.learn: Which offer details drive acceptance, so the acceptance template answers them up front.

evidence.claim: The acceptance or rejection letter can be automated; the decision itself cannot rest solely on automated processing.
Recruitee can send templated emails on stage changes and supports automatic deletion of candidate data after a set period.

assumptions: The decision is always made by a person and recorded as a stage move before any message goes out.
The Dutch privacy authority's guideline of four weeks retention, or one year with consent, is applied.
unknowns: How many hiring managers have Recruitee seats today.
Whether rejected applicants currently get any message at all, and how fast.
Whether acceptance messages must wait for the AFAS contract to be ready.
research_questions: What share of applicants in the last six months never received an answer, and how long did the rest wait?
Will hiring managers record decisions in Recruitee if the alternative is chasing by HR? Pilot on one site.
Does offer acceptance or candidate feedback change once answers are faster? Compare a quarter before and after.

43-4161.00:2699.short: Read applications in Recruitee, check them against job requirements, and pass suitable candidates to hiring managers.

steps.what: Open new applications in Recruitee and read CV and motivation

loop.input: CV and screening-question answers in Recruitee
loop.output: structured fields: certificates (forklift, VCA, food safety), driving licence, shift availability, work permit status, years in logistics, languages
loop.check: schema validation; each field must quote the span of CV text it came from; fields with no quote stay empty
loop.stop: one pass plus one retry per CV; on failure, mark the candidate 'manual read' in Recruitee
loop.why_not_simpler: CVs arrive as free-text PDFs in Dutch, English and Polish. Screening questions cover only part of the criteria.

steps.what: Check knock-out criteria: certificates, shifts, permit, location
Decide on the shortlist and write a short referral note
Send candidates to the hiring manager and chase feedback

43-4161.00:2699.design: A small extraction job reads new Recruitee applications and writes certificate, shift and permit fields back to the candidate profile. Deterministic rules per vacancy then mark each criterion as met, missing or unclear, and show it on the candidate card. The administrator confirms the shortlist; Recruitee automations send it to the hiring manager and send Teams reminders if there is no feedback after two days.
43-4161.00:2699.previous_blocker: Free-text CVs in several languages could not be turned into reliable fields without a person reading them. Knock-out criteria lived in people's heads, not in a table.
43-4161.00:2699.enabler_now: Language models extract fields from CVs with a quoted source span that can be checked. Recruitee exposes candidates and custom fields through its API. AI coding makes the rules table and job cheap to build.
43-4161.00:2699.still_hard: Judging near-misses: an expired VCA certificate, transferable experience, a candidate for another site. The legal frame also limits automation: from December 2027 screening becomes high-risk, so ranking or rejecting by machine is not an option.
43-4161.00:2699.human_edge: Seeing potential behind a thin CV and weighing it against what this manager and team need. The shortlist decision stays with a person, who can explain it.

ambition.what: Re-screen the whole Recruitee talent pool each time a new vacancy opens, so earlier applicants with a forklift or VCA certificate get referred again.

43-4161.00:2699.altitude: Screening time drops by about half. The administrator decides from a pre-filled criteria card instead of reading every CV, and owns the knock-out table per job family.

reach.learn: How hiring managers weigh criteria in practice, so the knock-out table matches real decisions.

evidence.claim: Screening and evaluating applicants becomes high-risk under the AI Act (Annex III 4(a)) from 2 December 2027.
A rejection cannot rest solely on automated processing under GDPR Art. 22.
A tool that processes applicant and employee personal data needs works council consent under WOR art. 27(1)(k).
Recruitee supports custom candidate fields, screening questions and stage-based automations through its interface and API.
Agent-style nudging of stalled approvals is a standard product feature.

assumptions: Most warehouse and driver vacancies have clear knock-out criteria such as certificates, shifts and licence.
Recruitee is the single intake channel; agency candidates do not go through this flow.
The extraction uses a model hosted in the EU under an AVG-compliant processing agreement.
unknowns: How many applications per month, split between warehouse, transport and office.
Whether the Recruitee plan includes API access and custom fields.
Whether the works council sees CV field extraction as a new system needing consent, or as part of Recruitee.
research_questions: On 100 past applications, how often do the extracted certificate and shift fields agree with what the administrator recorded?
How much of screening time is reading CVs and how much is deciding? Measure one week by timing it.
Do hiring managers act faster on a criteria card than on a forwarded CV? Measure time to feedback before and after.
Would the works council and the DPO accept field extraction without ranking, framed as preparation for a human decision?

43-4161.00:2701.short: Turn approved vacancy requests into ads, publish them externally and internally, and close them when filled.

steps.what: Receive the vacancy request from the manager and check approval
Write or adapt the vacancy text, salary scale and requirements

loop.input: function profile, CAO scale from a table, site, shift pattern, previous ad for this job family
loop.output: Dutch and English vacancy text in the house template
loop.check: salary range, scale and hours are copied from the table, not generated; a checklist checks required fields and excluding language (age, gender, nationality)
loop.stop: one draft and one revision; otherwise fall back to the last approved ad for the job family
loop.why_not_simpler: Ads must read well for different jobs and sites; fixed templates gave flat, identical texts.

steps.what: Publish on the career site, job boards and agency portals
Notify employees and flex workers of internal openings
Withdraw ads when the role is filled or cancelled

43-4161.00:2701.design: Managers submit vacancies through a Recruitee requisition or a Microsoft Forms and Power Automate flow, which checks approval against the AFAS formation. A drafting step fills the house template from the function profile and the CAO scale table; the administrator edits and approves. Recruitee multiposting then publishes it, a small job posts it to Teams, the SharePoint vacancy page and the warehouse screens, and the ads close when the stage changes to hired.
43-4161.00:2701.previous_blocker: Requests came by mail without a fixed format. Ad texts were rewritten by hand each time. Internal notices depended on someone remembering to post them on each site.
43-4161.00:2701.enabler_now: Recruitee requisitions and multiposting are configuration. Models draft acceptable ad text when facts come from tables. Teams and SharePoint posting can be scripted cheaply.
43-4161.00:2701.still_hard: Keeping function profiles and the CAO scale table current. Deciding where to advertise for scarce roles such as truck drivers. Reaching shift workers who rarely open Teams.
43-4161.00:2701.human_edge: Knowing what makes a job at the Venlo or Tilburg site attractive and which channel works for scarce roles, and pushing back on managers whose requirements are unrealistic.

ambition.what: Flex workers from the three agencies see every internal vacancy at the same time as employees, so good flex workers move into permanent roles.

43-4161.00:2701.altitude: The administrator edits and approves instead of writing and posting. They own the ad templates and the channel list, and a vacancy is live within a day of approval.

reach.task: Choosing sourcing channels and measuring their yield
reach.learn: Read the Recruitee source report to see which channels bring hires who stay 90 days.
How approved headcount links to vacancies, so requests that are not in the formation are caught early.

evidence.claim: Recruitee supports requisition approval, job board multiposting and closing jobs by stage.
Models draft acceptable HR documents when they work from a rules base that experts maintain.

assumptions: The CAOs or company policy require internal posting, and the Waadi requires that flex workers are informed of vacancies.
Function profiles exist for most job families.
The Recruitee plan includes the multiposting channels in use.
unknowns: How many vacancies per month, and what share are repeats of the same job family.
Whether hiring approval is recorded anywhere today, in AFAS or by mail.
Which job boards and agency channels are used, and their costs.
research_questions: How long is it today from manager request to live ad? Sample 20 vacancies.
How many past ads per job family could serve as reusable templates?
Do flex workers learn about internal vacancies today, and how many have moved to permanent roles in the past year?
